scope: Source/report inspection for parent-owned exploratory D6 tests; no D6 learner execution or additional GPU jobs by this reviewer. No empirical upper-ceiling proof.

latest139.current_reg: Gaussian corruption on all noisy layers, local train-label tangent augmentation, unsupervised reconstruction and teacher distillation; labels-only top-down decoder, hard-query oversampling and hidden HKNN.

experiment_implications: Increase STEPS and allocated schedules/minibatch/noise offsets consistently; all step counts must divide GK30 unless changing replay logic.
A4x/16x step probe is useful but still likely seconds per fit; evaluate the user’s longer wall-time budget separately.
Retain peak LR or intentionally tune it when extending training. Automatically dividing LR by step multiplier only preserves integrated budget.

Dropout can be applied after hidden ReLU only in loss, leaving clean predict unchanged; avoid final-logit dropout initially. Dropconnect can mask encoder matrices in loss, using original weights at predict.
For AdamW/L2, regularize encoder/decoder matrices separately from BN offsets/gain and combinator parameters initially.
Fixed-teacher query distillation can bias long training; tapering TW late is an informative ablation, while keeping teacher/readout constant for direct comparisons.
Track clean-current training accuracy alongside query accuracy to distinguish underfitting from overfitting; use paired fresh draws, then frozen independent11-draw confirmation.
Existing canonical60sec call/90sec later-warm limits cannot qualify five-minute fits. D6 development evidence must be labelled separately; this source’s D5 qualification uses unchanged stock rules.

Log clean training-error count, pre-guard HKNN/student accuracy and guard trigger. Strong regularization may cross the40-training-mistake threshold and cause confident query predictions to revert to the fixed teacher; a prespecified no-guard D6 ablation separates that effect. Qualification source remains unchanged.
